activity.description: Source-code-driven extraction of 16 claims about the Maarten-vd-Sande/lbm free-surface LBM (Thuerey VoF-epsilon family): method architecture, cell classification, mass ledger, and three mass-accounting pathologies (rho_prev copy bug, GAS-branch operator-precedence bug, silent mass destruction). Each claim carries a verbatim quote with file:line locator at commit 573a01c and a GAP anchor (GAP-LBM-FREESURFACE or self-defined sub-anchor GAP-LBM-FREESURFACE-MASS-LEDGER).
